propositions: tolerant_parse returns the first parseable JSON object in a reply instead of the intended schema-matching payload, allowing quoted tool results or examples to masquerade as the real contract object
five recurrent instances of schema-blind extraction defect have been partially fixed but re-broken by routine model swaps and provider cutoffs like the Bedrock migration
the prompted path must be hardened with schema-filtered candidate selection and last-valid-wins logic to guarantee correct contract-object extraction across all models

Bedrock native structured output requires SDK floor raise to botocore >= 1.43 to accept outputConfig client-side and measured per-model thinking-compatibility gating instead of blanket forced prompting
an explicit sentinel output channel directive must ship atomically with its extraction logic and an opt-in raw-reply artifact must preserve parse failures for debugging
provider-matrix baseline evaluation harness running as manual CI job must measure before/after raw-output distributions to validate the hardening and native-output migration decisions
